description: Convert a log from one format to another through OpenTelemetry's Logs Data Model: JSON, logfmt, syslog RFC 5424, CSV, OpenTelemetry or Elastic Common Schema. Tells you UP FRONT what the conversion loses — syslog only has eight severities and a text body, so coming down to it from JSON drops fields.

columns.description: CSV only: which fields become columns

format.description: Force the format instead of detecting it

from.description: Which end to read if the file is over 32 MB

path.description: Path to the log file. Use this for big logs: they do not fit in a tool call.

text.description: The log as text. Alternative to `path`.

name: log_convert
